Şebnem.definition:
The most [perfect person] in [the world]. They're usually shy and cute, but they also have a charming side. They are smart and strong women. They can do unexpected things when you least expect it. They usually like art, science. If you become friends with someone named Şebnem, don't leave them. [Love them].
(It also means dew)
